artifact.naga-town.harpoonlaucher.descri:
{Naga Harpoon Launcher}

The latest invention of ordnance scientists, a powerful tool for destroying enemy forces.
artifact.naga-town.harpoonlaucher.event: The Naga Harpoon Launcher, a universal war machine, allows you to attack enemy walls.
artifact.naga-town.harpoonlaucher.name: Naga Harpoon Launcher
building.naga-town.naga.blacksmith.descr: The Blacksmith provides your army with Naga Harpoon Launchers.
building.naga-town.naga.blacksmith.name: Blacksmith

building.naga-town.naga.capitol.name: Capitol

building.naga-town.naga.castle.name: Castle
building.naga-town.naga.citadel.descript: The Citadel increases the base growth rate of creatures by 50% and strengthens the town's defensive structures.
building.naga-town.naga.citadel.name: Citadel
building.naga-town.naga.cityHall.descrip: The City Hall allows you to purchase town buildings and provides 2,000 gold per day.

building.naga-town.naga.dwellingUpLvl7.d: The Dense Fog Abyss allows you to recruit Naga Dragon Turtles.

building.naga-town.naga.grail.name: Source Power

building.naga-town.naga.horde2Upgr.name: Triumphal Arch

creatures.naga-town.nagalv4th.descriptio:
{Skill Description}:
{Summon Water Elemental} The Naga Tidecaller can summon water elementals, with the quantity equal to the number of Naga Tidecallers.
faction.naga-town.naga.name: Naga
hero.naga-town.nagaathissa.biography: Athissa possesses extraordinary talent and an instinctive connection to the power of the tides. During her magical training, she finally unearthed her control over the tides and was granted the name 'Tide Mistress.'
hero.naga-town.nagaathissa.name: Tide Mistress Athissa
hero.naga-town.nagaathissa.specialty.des: The Power of the Tides reduces the speed of all enemy units by -1.
hero.naga-town.nagaathissa.specialty.too: Creature Bonus: Power of the Tides
hero.naga-town.nagadelacour.biography: Delacour is the chieftain of the Dragon Turtle clan, a friendly race that lived in the Dense Fog Abyss until they were enslaved by Queen Azshara to serve as the Naga's war machines. Queen Azshara triggered the ancestral power within Delacour, causing him to lose his self-awareness; this power can trigger the frenzy form of the Dragon Turtle clan.
hero.naga-town.nagadelacour.name: Delacour
hero.naga-town.nagadelacour.specialty.de: Upgrades Naga Dragon Turtles to Frenzy Dragon Turtles.
hero.naga-town.nagadelacour.specialty.to: Creature Bonus: Creature Upgrade: Frenzy Dragon Turtle
hero.naga-town.nagaheroparjesh.biography: Parjesh is the Captain of Queen Azshara's Royal Guard. The Naga Royal Guard he leads is a force directly under the Queen's jurisdiction. Only the most elite warriors among the Naga Guards are promoted to the Royal Guard, becoming Naga Royal Guards.
hero.naga-town.nagaheroparjesh.name: Parjesh
hero.naga-town.nagaheroparjesh.specialty: Allows Naga Guards to be upgraded to Naga Royal Guards.
Creature Bonus: Upgrade Creature: Naga Royal Guard
hero.naga-town.nagaheroslark.biography: Slark is the leader of the Murloc Warriors. The warriors he leads are the most dangerous predators among the murlocs. Their superb assassination techniques prevent enemies from tracking them, and they deliver fatal blows in critical moments.
hero.naga-town.nagaheroslark.name: Slark
hero.naga-town.nagaheroslark.specialty.d: Upgrades Murloc Hunters to Murloc Warriors.
hero.naga-town.nagaheroslark.specialty.t: Creature Bonus: Creature Upgrade: Murloc Warrior
hero.naga-town.nagakarathress.biography: Deep Lord Karathress possesses heroic divine power and is one of Queen Azshara's most loyal and brave ministers. The Naga Deathsworn he leads are the most fearless warriors among the Naga Guards, always charging on the front line.
hero.naga-town.nagakarathress.name: Karathress
Upgrades Naga Guards to Naga Deathsworn.
Creature Bonus: Upgrade Creature: Naga Deathsworn
hero.naga-town.nagamegafin.biography: Old Sharkmouth is a crossbreed of murloc and sea giant, raised in the ocean arena. He defeated countless brave fighters, rising from a low-level slave to become the King of the Arena. After experiencing countless life-and-death battles, he mastered the Power of Sea Combat.
hero.naga-town.nagamegafin.name: Old Sharkmouth
hero.naga-town.nagamegafin.specialty.des: Power of Sea Combat gives Old Sharkmouth +5 Attack and Defense in naval battles.
hero.naga-town.nagamorogrim.biography: Morogrim Tidewalker is the chieftain of the Sea Giant clan and the most powerful Tidewalker among them. He can train Tide Sea Giants to gain even greater power.
hero.naga-town.nagamorogrim.name: Morogrim Tidewalker
hero.naga-town.nagamorogrim.specialty.de: Allows Tide Sea Giants to be upgraded to Sea Giant Tidewalkers.
hero.naga-town.nagamorogrim.specialty.to: Creature Bonus: Creature Upgrade: Sea Giant Tidewalker
hero.naga-town.nagamurkeye.biography: In his younger years, Old Murkeye was the greatest tomb raider of the murloc race, moving freely through any terrain. However, he accidentally lost both eyes during an expedition. He is now the top scout of the murlocs; even without sight, he can accurately find the best path for an army.
hero.naga-town.nagamurkeye.name: Old Murkeye
hero.naga-town.nagamurkeye.specialty.des: Receives a 5% extra bonus per level to Logistics.
hero.naga-town.naganajentus.biography: Warlord Naj'entus is a warrior most proficient in battle techniques among the Naga, and was thus granted the rank of Warlord. He is a master of both melee and ranged combat and has a certain degree of resistance to magic.
hero.naga-town.naganajentus.name: Warlord Naj'entus
hero.naga-town.naganajentus.specialty.de: The base attack of the army led by the hero increases by 1% per level; the hero attack power provided by artifacts increases by an additional 1% per level.
hero.naga-town.naganazjan.biography: Naz'jan is the leader of the Cracklash tribe and the most 'business-minded' Naga, often calling himself Emperor. He possesses unparalleled wealth.
hero.naga-town.naganazjan.name: Emperor Naz'jan
hero.naga-town.naganazjan.specialty.desc: Provides an additional 350 gold per day to the kingdom.
hero.naga-town.naganazjan.specialty.name: +350 Gold
hero.naga-town.naganazjar.biography: Lady Naz'jar has shown exceptional talent in Water Magic since childhood. She once narrowly lost to Lady Vashj in a duel for Ocean Power, but her powerful water magic remains a force that cannot be ignored.
hero.naga-town.naganazjar.name: Lady Naz'jar
hero.naga-town.naganazjar.specialty.desc: Increases Water Magic damage by 5% per level.
hero.naga-town.naganazjar.specialty.name: Water Magic
hero.naga-town.nagasarevess.biography: Sarevess is one of the most talented Naga Sea Witches. Her unique understanding of magic makes the spells she casts extremely aggressive.
hero.naga-town.nagasarevess.name: Sarevess
hero.naga-town.nagasarevess.specialty.de: Receives a 5% extra bonus per level to Sorcery.
hero.naga-town.nagasashjtar.biography: Sashj'tar is the elder sister of Sassz'ine. Unlike her sister who loves studying magic, Sashj'tar is dedicated to conquering the sea and becoming a great navigator.
hero.naga-town.nagasashjtar.name: Sashj'tar
hero.naga-town.nagasashjtar.specialty.de: Receives a 5% extra bonus per level to Navigation.
hero.naga-town.nagasasszine.biography: Sassz'ine is the head of the Naga Mage Guild and the most knowledgeable Naga Sea Witch. Her vast knowledge gives her an incredible mana reserve, and she enjoys researching magic even during military campaigns.
hero.naga-town.nagasasszine.name: Sassz'ine
hero.naga-town.nagasasszine.specialty.de: Receives a 15% extra bonus per level to Mysticism.
hero.naga-town.nagasirakess.biography: Lady Sirakess is a Naga blessed by the power of the wind and is the youngest Sea Witch. During her magical training, she awakened the Gale Domain.
hero.naga-town.nagasirakess.name: Lady Sirakess
hero.naga-town.nagasirakess.specialty.de: All creatures led by the hero get +1 Defense and +1 Speed; the defense value is added directly to the hero's defense.
hero.naga-town.nagathreek.biography: The ancient Souring Snake lineage is the ancestor of today's Winged and Flying Snakes. These snakes were originally unintelligent beasts until they were tamed by the Naga. Threek once belonged to an elite Winged Snake unit. During a battle, he accidentally fell into a deep valley where his trace of Souring Snake blood activated the remains of an ancient Souring Snake, granting him ancient toxic power and awakening his intelligence. Threek's blood can cause Winged Snakes to revert to Souring Snakes.
hero.naga-town.nagathreek.name: Threek
hero.naga-town.nagathreek.specialty.desc: Upgrades Winged Snakes to Souring Snakes.
hero.naga-town.nagathreek.specialty.name: Souring Snake
hero.naga-town.nagathreek.specialty.tool: Creature Bonus: Creature Upgrade: Souring Snake
hero.naga-town.nagavashj.biography: Lady Vashj masters Ocean Power and is the strongest element magic user among the Naga Sea Witches. The Naga Sea Siren unit she leads also inherits her power.
hero.naga-town.nagavashj.name: Lady Vashj
hero.naga-town.nagavashj.specialty.descr: Upgrades Naga Sea Sirens to Naga Tidecallers.
hero.naga-town.nagavashj.specialty.name: Naga Tidecaller
hero.naga-town.nagavashj.specialty.toolt: Creature Bonus: Creature Upgrade: Naga Tidecaller
hero.naga-town.nagaxiz.biography: Lord Xiz is the most valiant Venomfin Dragon chieftain of the Naga. He is proudest of his Curse Power; the Venomfin Dragons he leads inherit this power to become even stronger.
hero.naga-town.nagaxiz.name: Lord Xiz
hero.naga-town.nagaxiz.specialty.descrip: Upgrades Venomfin Dragons to Cursefin Dragons.
hero.naga-town.nagaxiz.specialty.name: Cursefin Dragon
hero.naga-town.nagaxiz.specialty.tooltip: Creature Bonus: Creature Upgrade: Cursefin Dragon
hero.naga-town.nagazalgira.biography: Zalgira is the captain of the Naga Demon Hunter squad. Her squad possesses superb shooting skills.
hero.naga-town.nagazalgira.name: Zalgira
hero.naga-town.nagazalgira.specialty.des: Upgrades Naga Sea Sirens to Naga Demon Hunters.
hero.naga-town.nagazalgira.specialty.too: Creature Bonus: Creature Upgrade: Naga Demon Hunter
hero.naga-town.nagazithreen.biography: Zithreen is the most restless Sea Witch among the Naga. In her early years, she traveled everywhere to learn magic from other races. Thanks to her tireless studies, she can adapt various magical powers for her own use and improve existing spells.
hero.naga-town.nagazithreen.name: Zithreen
hero.naga-town.nagazithreen.specialty.de: Spell duration +1. Every unit can absorb 1 mana from enemy heroes, plus 1 additional mana for every 10 levels.

heroClass.naga-town.nagaseawitch.name: Naga Sea Witch
